# NotificationShowResult

`Flare.Components.NotificationShowResult`

What happened to a notification passed to ShowAsync.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Shown` | `0` | The notification was handed to the system. |
| `PermissionNotGranted` | `1` | Not shown: the user has not allowed notifications (or has blocked them). |
| `Unsupported` | `2` | Not shown: the browser has no notifications here, or the page is not interactive yet. |
| `Failed` | `3` | Not shown: the browser refused it for another reason. |
